desc: Ideation: trie formulation; answer[i] = max(on-path nodes with count-1>=k, off-path nodes with count>=k); per-depth top-2 qualifying nodes + descending scan bounded by word length.

Implement the full trie-based solution: build trie with per-node counts, record each word's path node ids, compute per-depth top-2 qualifying nodes and sorted qualifying depths, then per word compute answer = max(P_i, Q_i) with O(1) path-membership via timestamped visited marks.
Verify the implementation against both provided examples and key edge cases (k=1, k=n, n-1<k, duplicates, prefix words), and confirm complexity O(sum of lengths) time/space.
